sentence: This project studies how diatoms use light-driven proton pumps to make energy when the light is strong and iron is low.
This project builds mathematical tools to understand materials and their defects and to help with image analysis.
This project builds a framework that helps autonomous agents and humans work together more safely.
This project builds educational modules that teach how to use artificial intelligence tools in computing and social science research.
This project studies how the genes of wheat, tomato and poplar shape the microbes around them and help them resist disease and drought.
This project studies how few times an algorithm must query a matrix to solve problems in linear algebra.
This project builds hands-on labs that use cloud-based virtual environments to teach artificial intelligence methods for cybersecurity problems.
This project builds tools that let underwater robots understand language instructions, interpret sonar observations, and act on their own.
This project develops mathematical and computational methods to calibrate atmospheric models so they are more accurate.
This project studies how zebrafish embryos recover from early problems in heart formation and still build a working heart.
This project builds liquid electrolytes for sodium-ion and potassium-ion batteries and uses machine learning to speed up the search.
This project builds a training program about how to detect, identify and respond to dangerous drone activity.
This project builds a program that teaches cybersecurity through a multidisciplinary minor and applied learning.
This project brings scientists together to work out how wildfire particles travel through the air and affect lakes.
This project studies how a plant egg cell uses actin filaments to move the sperm nucleus after fertilization.
This project studies which proteins help pollen grains form the special regions on their surface called apertures.
This project builds a system that uses printing and lasers to make qubit arrays for quantum computing.
